limits: Hexes are approximations at game-map scale, not precise historical drop-zone coordinates.
The British glider operation is abstracted through the existing airborne system.
Player must order the supporting amphibious invasion and launch the airdrop; target presets do not validate aircraft capacity or trigger a launch.
The13 July Primosole operation and later airborne campaigns are not automatically scheduled.
